sections.title: Describe weather across several days
sections.content: Combine days, time expressions, weather expressions and familiar activities to describe a simple week.

items.spanish: Hoy hace sol y voy al parque.
items.english: Today it is sunny and I go to the park.

items.spanish: Mañana hace frío y trabajo en casa.
items.english: Tomorrow it is cold and I work at home.

items.spanish: El viernes hace calor y tomo agua.
items.english: On Friday it is hot and I drink water.

sections.content: Put the day or time expression first when useful: Hoy..., mañana..., el lunes..., por la mañana...
